extracted.name: Squash Medley
extracted.description: This is a really easy side dish to throw together when your looking for an extra serving of veggies to add to your meal.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 yellow or red onion, coarsely chopped
1/2 tsp. each salt-free all purpose seasoning, garlic powder
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil in a large, deep skillet with a tight fitting lid over medium heat. Once its hot, add the onion and peppers and stir them to coat in oil. Let them cook until they start to soften up a bit, then add the zucchini and yellow squash to the pan. Pop the lid on and let it cook fairly undisturbed for 3 or so minutes. Then add the seasonings and stir. Continue cooking until the squash is your desired tenderness (I usually cook mine for 10ish minutes). Then serve it up.
